intro: Melor Stonehoof sends you to the Alterac Mountains to hunt Frostmaw, a rarely seen yeti. A scroll explains how to lure him, and Melor awaits Frostmaw’s mane in Thunder Bluff.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, it is now time for you to travel to far-off lands. You are ready.
You now hunt Frostmaw, a yeti in the Alterac Mountains. He is elusive, his white coat blending into the snows of his mountain home. He rarely shows himself.
But I will show you how to entice a creature such as he. Here, take this scroll. On it I have written how Frostmaw may be lured.
Now go, friend. Your journey is long and many challenges lay waiting. When you return with Frostmaw's mane, only then is your task complete.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been to the Alterac Mountains, friend? Did you face the elusive Frostmaw?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Both strength and cunning were needed to find and defeat Frostmaw, friend. You have both.
Your path has taken you to the valleys of Thousand Needles and to the high mountains of Alterac. It will one day lead you through all the Earthmother's lands, for such is the way of the hunter.
